rows.quote: Here, we investigated 6432 plasma proteins (1533 previously unstudied in large-scale proteomic GWAS) using the SomaLogic (v4.1) aptamer-based technology in a Scottish population from the Viking Genes study.
rows.coder_note: Sentence names the Viking Genes study as the population of the paper's own pQTL analysis; the dictionary has no row for it.
